collateralizationRatio.rationale: System CR = sum(deposit_value)/sum(borrow_value) across BtcFi market handlers from issuer market API. Pin: deposits $7,974,538.63 / BtcUSD debt $6,094,953.39 = 1.308384. Handlers include multiple BTC-wrapped deposits (ids 0,1,3,4) plus BNC (id 5) against BtcUSD borrow (id 2). DefiLlama 183 independently shows ~$6.05M circulating BtcUSD near the debt print (supply-side check, not a second CR oracle).

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: BtcUSD is issued from a shared over-collateralized lending market; liquidations are executed by external keepers repaying debt for discounted collateral. No dedicated BtcUSD-committed stability/offset pool exists in the market state API (no stability-pool balance field), so a pool-to-supply liquidation-capacity ratio is not applicable.
